note: Roger Mills County has no centralized planning or zoning department and publishes no zoning district layer; searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found only county census/municipal boundary layers (twoody_uok Roger_Mills_County_Data), no zoning. Cheyenne and Reydon, the county's towns, show no published zoning GIS or ordinance map; Sayre's zoning is in Beckham County and published only as code text.
